query: Earlier I saw a decorated jar from the Middle Predynastic period, and later a silver ewer from the Early Byzantine era. What is the approximate number of years between the creation of these two artifacts?

events.description: A close-up shot of the decorated jar from the Middle Predynastic period, along with its description label showing the date of creation.
A detailed shot showing the silver ewer from the Early Byzantine era and its museum display label detailing its era of creation.
